name: Clove oil
indication_description: Clove oil is indicated in Bad breath (Halitosis), Tooth decay, Oral thrush, Dental pain, Inflammation of the mouth and pharynx.
pharmacology_description: Clove oil is a herbal medicine which main ingredient is clove oil. It contains a large amount of eugenol that is commonly used in the treatment of oral infections and inflammation of the mucous membranes of the mouth and throat. Clove oil is effective, safe and well tolerated for all age groups
dosage_description:
Adult: Should be taken 5 ml Clove oil with 10 ml-15 ml water and gurgle for 30 seconds of morning & bedtime daily.

Children: Should be taken 2.5 ml Clove oil with 10 ml water and gurgle for 30 seconds of morning & bedtime daily. Also undiluted clove oil is used in temporary relief of toothache due to dental cavity. Repeat administration after 20 minutes, then every 2 hours thereafter if necessary.
side_effects_description: In concentrated form oil of clove may be irritating to mucosal tissues.
pregnancy_and_lactation_description: There are no known problems with the use of Clove oil during pregnancy and lactation.
storage_conditions_description: Store below 30°C. temperature & dry place, protected from light. Keep all medicines out of reach of children.
